description: Implementation of TimerManager for managing timers using event loop and timer factory, including adding, removing, and handling timer expirations.

classes.name: TimerManagerImpl
classes.description: Class managing timers, including adding, removing, and handling timer expirations using an event loop and timer factory.

methods.name: TimerManagerImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing timer factory and event loop, with null pointer checks.

methods.name: ~TimerManagerImpl
methods.description: Destructor that removes all remaining timers.

methods.name: add_timer
methods.description: Creates and schedules a new timer, registers event handlers, and stores it in the timer list.

methods.name: remove_timer
methods.description: Removes a timer given its file descriptor, cancels it, and unregisters event handlers.

methods.name: handle_read
methods.description: Handles timer expiration event, reads expiration count, and logs overrun warnings if needed.
